title: Leantime JSON-RPC 2.0 Request
description: Request shape for all Leantime JSON-RPC 2.0 API calls. Derived from app/Domain/Api/Controllers/Jsonrpc.php.

method.description: Format: leantime.rpc.{module}.{service}.{method} or leantime.rpc.{module}.{method} (service defaults to module name)

params.description: Method parameters. Matched by name to service method parameters via PHP Reflection.
